correctness.rationale: For B>3c²/4 the objective Hessian is uniformly positive: its v diagonal minimizes to 1-3c²/(4B)>0. At a start (x,0) the cubic Taylor model omits Bv⁴, and Hessian lower-right positivity at h=0 forces t≥3c²/4. At t0, every unit-direction Hessian quadratic form has global minimum (1-q²)²(1+2q²)≥0; nonhomogeneous two-variable quartic convexity is SOS-convexity by Ahmadi–Parrilo. Symmetry and strict convexity force v_+=0. Boundary derivative of λy+y²/2+(3c²/4)(y-x)^4 is λ-3c²x³, establishing iff, including equality. For λ=0, unique interior iterate solves x_+=3c²(x-x_+)³, remains positive, decreases to zero and gives exact cubic coefficient; finite nonidentification is proved analytically. I independently re-derived the Hessian, discriminant, convexity factorization and boundary derivative with symbolic algebra.
